node.title: PROVED (all h): <= floor(n/h) partners per anchored core
node.statement: For ANY h and any anchored core P: partners Q with L_Q = L_P - c are injectively indexed by c in the value set {L_P(x) : x in mu_n}, giving <= floor(n/h) partners per core (each partner consumes h roots). Uniform-in-h sharpening of the h=3 cubic-cap mechanism; verified numerically. Reduces every per-h trade bound to bounding ACTIVE cores.
